title: Dead Reckoning Task
description: One unit of work, as handed to dr run or dropped into a node's inbox. One task per file; the runtime picks it up atomically and moves it to inbox/done/ when it reaches a decision.

task_id.description: Unique on this node. Checkpoints and every record from this task key on it.

task_class.description: Names a [task_classes.<name>] block, which supplies min_rank, review_above_rank and the budget.

subject.description: The domain entity this task is about, e.g. 'ticket:T-104'. Steps for one subject are serialised within a node, and conflict detection across nodes keys on it.

working_set.description: Subject identifiers this task expects to touch, used to scope hydration. Flat and explicit: the runtime expands nothing.
